title: The Revival of the Dying Message
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Ran, Sonoko, Kogoro, Inspector Megure, Chiba) omitted by convention -- Sonoko's restroom-door testimony and Chihiro's phone are preserved via clue/object nodes instead of a person node for her. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed, attributed edge between the entities involved. The old wiki-derived case file already named the correct murderer (Izumi Sano) but flattened the plot: (1) its clue c2 says the blood-on-skate-blade belonged to the VICTIM's own skates -- the transcript is explicit the blood trail is on the KILLER Izumi's skate blade, left when she stepped in the pool of blood while forging the wall message, which is the actual clinching physical clue; getting whose skate it was backwards is a real error, not just a simplification. (2) It omits the entire middle act: Kogoro/Conan's first S-based accusation of Sano is shown to be logically broken (a victim shot instantly through the chest cannot write a message in her own blood afterward), so Conan deliberately stages a FALSE public accusation of Kunitomo Oda-san (announced 'this time I'm certain!') purely to smoke out the real killer's reaction, before pivoting back to the true, evidence-backed case against Izumi -- modeled here as circumstance_tags ["red_herring","staged_accusation"] on the relevant implicates edges. (3) It omits the five-yen-coin trick (whistling through a coin held to the lips reproduces the whistle of an incoming firework, letting Izumi mask the timing of the gunshot as the first of the three-firework opening sequence) and the reverse-psychology logic behind the self-incriminating 'S': Izumi wrote her own initial in blood banking on the deduction 'no real killer frames herself,' which was intended to throw suspicion onto Oda, the one clay-shooting-club member without a fireworks alibi. (4) It omits the deeper motive layer -- Izumi's target wasn't just 'the victim was mean to her ex'; Narita (the ex, dead by suicide 6 months prior) told Izumi by phone, while she was sick in bed, that Chihiro had dumped him AND that Chihiro was secretly seeing Oda (Izumi's own boyfriend at the time) -- Oda denies the affair, calling it a lie Chihiro told to make Narita jealous, and admits he brushed off Narita's confrontation because he was preoccupied caring for Izumi's illness. label.murderer_id unchanged from the old file (p3, Izumi Sano) -- the old file's culprit was correct. case_type: murder.

clues.desc: The victim was shot in the chest and died instantly, which is physically incompatible with her then writing a message in her own blood on the wall -- proves the "S" was staged by someone else after the fact, not left by the dying victim.

Traces of the victim's blood are found on the blade of Izumi Sano's ice skate in the corridor between the restroom and the rink -- she stepped in the pool of blood while forging the wall message and unknowingly tracked it out with her, proving she was in the restroom after the killing.

A witness's description of a hooded, scarved figure leaving the restroom right after what she took for a firework whistle-and-bang matches the coat and scarf later found discarded in a trash bin between the restroom and the rink.
